what: A hand-labelled truth set for the CANDIDATE half of services/project/src/coins.ts, measured against the 205 rows in public.asset (13 written by tools/seed.mjs, 192 real PumpPortal mints). Every pair below is one the CURRENT rule admits. TRUE means a human would agree the coin is plausibly named after that story; FALSE means it matched on a common or accidental token.

howBuilt.candidateRule: coin is a candidate iff any token of normalise(symbol) or normalise(name) is a token of any normalised span  — coins.ts coinCandidates, verbatim
howBuilt.confidentRule: coin is confident iff normalise(symbol) or normalise(name) EQUALS a whole normalised span  — unchanged, and out of scope for any proposal
howBuilt.spansFrom: public.item_fingerprint where kind='entitySpan', joined through public.story_member, deduplicated  — db.ts loadEntitySpans
howBuilt.mintWindow: a.minted_at is null OR story has no min(item.posted_at) OR minted_at in [opensAt+minLagMs, opensAt+maxLagMs]  — db.ts loadCoinsInWindow

caveats: RECALL IS ONLY MEASURABLE ON SEEDED DATA. All 13 TRUE pairs are the 13 seeded assets. Not one of the 192 real mints is plausibly named after any of the six stories — the stories are invented and the mints are a real four-minute slice of pump.fun plus an hour-later slice. So this set measures PRECISION against real adversarial text and RECALL against fiction. A rule that loses a TRUE pair here is still broken; a rule that keeps all 13 has not been proven safe on real coins, because there are none to be safe on.

THE WINDOW IS DOING WORK THE TEXT RULE IS BEING CREDITED FOR. Fourteen further coins text-match a span and are removed only by the six-hour mint window: 11 more "the" matches for st_soup, GRANDMA for st_dance, "just" for st_chillguy, "to" for st_ferry. See windowSuppressed below. Judge a text proposal on that set too, or a later change to the window will reopen a hole this fixture says is closed.

THE WINDOWS ARE ANCHORED TO WHEN tools/seed.mjs LAST RAN. Seed times are relative to load time; the real mints are fixed instants. Re-running db:seed moves every story window and changes retrievedInWindow. The labelled pairs are pinned here so scoring stays reproducible regardless; `corpus` is included so a document-frequency proposal can be computed without a database.

Only the pairs under stories[].candidates carry hand labels. Anything in `corpus` that a NEW rule admits and that is not in that list is unlabelled and must be judged by hand before it counts either way.

stories.note: The span "just a chill guy" contributes the stopwords "a" and "just". "a" admits four copies of one spam mint. "just" text-matches META / "hacked slop, just quit bro" — kept off only by the window. Note the seed asserts that st_pigeon and st_dance avoid stopwords deliberately and implies the others are fine; st_chillguy is not.

windowSuppressed.ambiguous: The hardest call in the set. "grandma" is a content word, not a stopword, and this coin carries it as BOTH ticker and name — a document-frequency rule keeps it (df 2 of 205) and only the window removes it. A human shown "Grandmother learns the dance, does it better" and a coin called GRANDMA minted sixteen hours later would say "possibly, but nothing here says so". Labelled FALSE on that reading, and flagged because a defensible person could label it TRUE.
